misprints.note: Circumflex printed on the ending, in 'låta ngn r., ἐπαγεῖν τινι τὴν ψῆφον'.
The letter is shaped like υ. It could also be a damaged ο.

uncertain.note: The first letter of ὀχεῖσθαι is broken: only a faint ο-shape and a breathing are visible. The OCR read ἰχεῖσθαι.
The ψ is broken and looks like ιψ. I read it as plain ψ.
A stray mark (breathing or accent?) sits between the comma and ικος. I treated it as displaced type or dust and left the ending without an accent.
There is a solid dot above the first a of the headword, unlike the ring of å. I took it for dust and kept 'Sago'.
Printed as 's ,' with a gap. The full stop after s may not have inked. I left it as 's,'.
